=== RESEARCH COMPLETE ===

**Integrations Researched: 3**
- **Agentation**: Verified ✓ - Visual feedback tool for AI coding agents
- **agentation-mcp**: Verified ✓ - MCP server for real-time annotation sync  
- **Model Context Protocol**: Verified ✓ - Already integrated in project

**Unverified Claims: 3**
- React 19 compatibility: **low risk** (React 18+ should work)
- Electron environment support: **low risk** (uses Chromium renderer)
- PolyForm Shield license compatibility: **medium risk** (needs legal review)

**Key Findings:**

1. **Agentation Package** ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/agentation)):
   - Install: `npm install agentation -D`
   - React 18+ peer dependency (project uses React 19.2.3)
   - Desktop browser only (should work with Electron's Chromium renderer)
   - 9 MCP tools available for annotation management

2. **Project Compatibility**:
   - MCP infrastructure already exists (`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.0.4`)
   - Existing MCP files: `mcp-manager.ts`, `mcp-server.ts`, `mcp-handlers.ts`
   - Can extend existing setup rather than parallel implementation

3. **Workflow from Article** ([Habr](https://habr.com/ru/amp/publications/1000726/)):
   - Click UI element → Agentation captures CSS selectors + position
   - Developer adds notes → Structured markdown output
   - MCP enables real-time agent integration (v2.0 feature)
   - Eliminates "vague description" problem for AI agents

**Recommendations:**
- Install agentation as devDependency
- Extend existing MCP infrastructure instead of separate server
- Create MCP bridge tool connecting annotations → spec_runner.py
- Test React 19 compatibility before full integration
- Review PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 license for restrictions

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code
    47→- `apps/frontend/src/main/` - Electron main process
    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |
    87→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI |
    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization
   212→
   213→## Requirements
   214→
   215→### Functional Requirements
   216→
   217→1. **Annotation Mode Toggle**
   218→   - Description: Users can enable/disable annotation mode via a toolbar button
   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→
   221→2. **Visual Annotation Drawing**
   222→   - Description: When annotation mode is active, users can click/drag to highlight UI areas
   223→   - Acceptance: Annotations appear as visual overlays with bounding boxes
   224→
   225→3. **Annotation Description Input**
   226→   - Description: Users can add text descriptions and severity levels to annotations
   227→   - Acceptance: Form appears after marking an area, captures description + severity
   228→
   229→4. **Screenshot Capture**
   230→   - Description: System automatically captures screenshot of annotated area
   231→   - Acceptance: Screenshot stored with annotation data for context
   232→
   233→5. **Task Creation from Annotation**
   234→   - Description: Submitted annotations create task entries in spec format
   235→   - Acceptance: New spec folder created in `.auto-claude/specs/` with annotation data
   236→
   237→6. **Annotation List View**
   238→   - Description: Users can view all annotations made in current session
   239→   - Acceptance: List shows all annotations with ability to edit/delete
   240→
   241→### Non-Functional Requirements
   242→
   243→1. **Dev-Only Activation**
   244→   - Description: Feature completely absent from production builds
   245→   - Acceptance: No annotation code in production bundle, verified via bundle analysis
   246→
   247→2. **React 19 Compatibility**

#!/bin/bash

# Auto-Build Environment Setup
# Feature: UX Feedback Loop - Visual Annotation System
# Generated by Planner Agent

set -e

echo "========================================"
echo "UX Annotation System - Dev Environment"
echo "========================================"

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Navigate to frontend
FRONTEND_DIR="apps/frontend"

if [ ! -d "$FRONTEND_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: Frontend directory not found: $FRONTEND_DIR${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if npm dependencies are installed
if [ ! -d "$FRONTEND_DIR/node_modules" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Installing npm dependencies...${NC}"
    cd "$FRONTEND_DIR"
    npm install
    cd ../..
fi

# ============================================
# START FRONTEND SERVICE
# ============================================

echo ""
echo "Starting Frontend (Electron + Vite)..."
echo ""

cd "$FRONTEND_DIR"

# Start dev server (Vite + Electron)
npm run dev &
DEV_PID=$!

# Wait for dev server to start
echo "Waiting for dev server to initialize..."
sleep 5

# ============================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================

echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo -e "${GREEN}Environment Ready!${NC}"
echo "========================================"
echo ""
echo "Services:"
echo "  Frontend:  Electron app (Vite dev server)"
echo ""
echo "Note: Annotation mode is only available in dev mode."
echo "  - Look for annotation toggle in toolbar"
echo "  - Enable to start marking UI areas"
echo ""
echo "Process ID: $DEV_PID"
echo "Press Ctrl+C to stop"
echo ""

# Wait for process to finish
wait $DEV_PID

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code
    47→- `apps/frontend/src/main/` - Electron main process
    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |
    87→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI |
    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code
    47→- `apps/frontend/src/main/` - Electron main process
    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |
    87→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI |
    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization
   212→
   213→## Requirements
   214→
   215→### Functional Requirements
   216→
   217→1. **Annotation Mode Toggle**
   218→   - Description: Users can enable/disable annotation mode via a toolbar button
   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→
   221→2. **Visual Annotation Drawing**
   222→   - Description: When annotation mode is active, users can click/drag to highlight UI areas
   223→   - Acceptance: Annotations appear as visual overlays with bounding boxes
   224→
   225→3. **Annotation Description Input**
   226→   - Description: Users can add text descriptions and severity levels to annotations
   227→   - Acceptance: Form appears after marking an area, captures description + severity
   228→
   229→4. **Screenshot Capture**
   230→   - Description: System automatically captures screenshot of annotated area
   231→   - Acceptance: Screenshot stored with annotation data for context
   232→
   233→5. **Task Creation from Annotation**
   234→   - Description: Submitted annotations create task entries in spec format
   235→   - Acceptance: New spec folder created in `.auto-claude/specs/` with annotation data
   236→
   237→6. **Annotation List View**
   238→   - Description: Users can view all annotations made in current session
   239→   - Acceptance: List shows all annotations with ability to edit/delete
   240→
   241→### Non-Functional Requirements
   242→
   243→1. **Dev-Only Activation**
   244→   - Description: Feature completely absent from production builds
   245→   - Acceptance: No annotation code in production bundle, verified via bundle analysis
   246→
   247→2. **React 19 Compatibility**

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code
    47→- `apps/frontend/src/main/` - Electron main process
    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |
    87→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI |
    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization
   212→
   213→## Requirements
   214→
   215→### Functional Requirements
   216→
   217→1. **Annotation Mode Toggle**
   218→   - Description: Users can enable/disable annotation mode via a toolbar button
   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→
   221→2. **Visual Annotation Drawing**
   222→   - Description: When annotation mode is active, users can click/drag to highlight UI areas
   223→   - Acceptance: Annotations appear as visual overlays with bounding boxes
   224→
   225→3. **Annotation Description Input**
   226→   - Description: Users can add text descriptions and severity levels to annotations
   227→   - Acceptance: Form appears after marking an area, captures description + severity
   228→
   229→4. **Screenshot Capture**
   230→   - Description: System automatically captures screenshot of annotated area
   231→   - Acceptance: Screenshot stored with annotation data for context
   232→
   233→5. **Task Creation from Annotation**
   234→   - Description: Submitted annotations create task entries in spec format
   235→   - Acceptance: New spec folder created in `.auto-claude/specs/` with annotation data
   236→
   237→6. **Annotation List View**
   238→   - Description: Users can view all annotations made in current session
   239→   - Acceptance: List shows all annotations with ability to edit/delete
   240→
   241→### Non-Functional Requirements

   244→   - Description: Feature completely absent from production builds
   245→   - Acceptance: No annotation code in production bundle, verified via bundle analysis

Subtask **subtask-4-1** is now complete. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Summary

Created annotation IPC handlers following the pattern from `mcp-handlers.ts` and `template-handlers.ts`:

### New File: `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/annotation-handlers.ts`

**IPC Handlers:**
- **`ANNOTATION_SUBMIT`**: Creates annotation from capture data, saves to JSON storage, and optionally triggers spec generation via `AnnotationToSpecService`
- **`ANNOTATION_GET`**: Retrieves a single annotation by ID
- **`ANNOTATION_LIST`**: Lists annotations with optional filtering by status and route (sorted by timestamp desc)
- **`ANNOTATION_DELETE`**: Deletes annotation and optionally removes generated spec folder

**Storage:** Annotations are persisted to `annotations.json` in the app's userData directory

**Features:**
- UUID generation using `uuid` package
- Input validation for coordinates, description length, severity, and screenshot data
- Error handling with proper IPCResult responses
- Integration with `AnnotationToSpecService` for spec generation
- Logging via `appLog`

### Modified File: `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/index.ts`
- Added import for `registerAnnotationHandlers`
- Registered handlers in `setupIpcHandlers` function
- Added to re-export list

- ✅ Committed with proper format: `feat(ipc): create annotation IPC handlers...`

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code

    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |

    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization
   212→
   213→## Requirements
   214→
   215→### Functional Requirements
   216→
   217→1. **Annotation Mode Toggle**
   218→   - Description: Users can enable/disable annotation mode via a toolbar button
   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→
   221→2. **Visual Annotation Drawing**
   222→   - Description: When annotation mode is active, users can click/drag to highlight UI areas
   223→   - Acceptance: Annotations appear as visual overlays with bounding boxes
   224→
   225→3. **Annotation Description Input**
   226→   - Description: Users can add text descriptions and severity levels to annotations
   227→   - Acceptance: Form appears after marking an area, captures description + severity
   228→
   229→4. **Screenshot Capture**
   230→   - Description: System automatically captures screenshot of annotated area
   231→   - Acceptance: Screenshot stored with annotation data for context
   232→
   233→5. **Task Creation from Annotation**
   234→   - Description: Submitted annotations create task entries in spec format
   235→   - Acceptance: New spec folder created in `.auto-claude/specs/` with annotation data
   236→
   237→6. **Annotation List View**
   238→   - Description: Users can view all annotations made in current session
   239→   - Acceptance: List shows all annotations with ability to edit/delete
   240→
   241→### Non-Functional Requirements
   242→
   243→1. **Dev-Only Activation**
   244→   - Description: Feature completely absent from production builds
   245→   - Acceptance: No annotation code in production bundle, verified via bundle analysis
   246→

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→

    52→

    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→

    73→

    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```

    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|

    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |

   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization

   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→

   237→6. **Annotation List View**

1→# Specification: Integrate UX Feedback Loop into Prototype Development
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This feature integrates a visual UX feedback loop into the Auto-Claude Electron application's development workflow. Based on the approach described in the Habr article (agentation-style visual annotation), developers will be able to annotate UI defects and gaps directly on the running prototype, with annotations automatically converted into actionable tasks/specs within the existing Auto-Claude pipeline. This eliminates friction between identifying UI issues and tracking them, accelerating the prototype-to-production workflow.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This introduces new functionality—a visual annotation layer integrated with the task creation pipeline—rather than modifying existing behavior. It requires new components, new event handling, and integration with existing MCP infrastructure.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **frontend** (primary) - Electron/React application where visual annotation UI will be rendered
    17→- **backend** (integration) - Spec creation pipeline that will receive annotation-derived tasks
    18→
    19→### This Task Will:
    20→- [ ] Install and configure the `agentation` package as a devDependency
    21→- [ ] Create a development-only annotation overlay component
    22→- [ ] Hook annotation submissions into existing MCP server infrastructure
    23→- [ ] Create annotation-to-task transformation logic
    24→- [ ] Store annotations and generate specs/tasks in `.auto-claude/specs/` format
    25→- [ ] Provide UI controls to enable/disable annotation mode
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Production deployment of annotation features (dev-only)
    29→- External task management integration (Jira, Linear, etc.) - handled by existing integrations
    30→- Mobile/touch annotation support
    31→- Multi-user collaborative annotation
    32→- Running separate agentation-mcp server (will use existing MCP infrastructure)
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Frontend (Primary Service)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React 19.x + Electron 40.6.0
    41→- State Management: Zustand
    42→- Styling: Tailwind CSS
    43→- Build Tool: Vite
    44→
    45→**Key Directories:**
    46→- `apps/frontend/src/` - Source code
    47→- `apps/frontend/src/main/` - Electron main process
    48→- `apps/frontend/src/renderer/` - React renderer process
    49→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` - Existing MCP manager
    50→- `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` - Existing MCP server
    51→- `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` - MCP IPC handlers
    52→
    53→**Entry Point:** `apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts`
    54→
    55→**How to Run:**
    56→```bash
    57→cd apps/frontend && npm run dev
    58→```
    59→
    60→**Port:** 3000 (Vite dev server)
    61→
    62→### Backend (Integration)
    63→
    64→**Tech Stack:**
    65→- Language: Python 3.12+
    66→- Package Manager: pip/uv
    67→
    68→**Key Directories:**
    69→- `apps/backend/spec_agents/` - Spec creation agents
    70→- `apps/backend/specs/` - Spec storage location
    71→
    72→**Entry Point:** `apps/backend/spec_runner.py`
    73→
    74→**How to Run:**
    75→```bash
    76→cd apps/backend && python spec_runner.py --interactive
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Files to Modify
    80→
    81→| File | Service | What to Change |
    82→|------|---------|---------------|
    83→| `apps/frontend/package.json` | frontend | Add `agentation` as devDependency |
    84→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | frontend | Add conditional Agentation component wrapper |
    85→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | frontend | Add annotation handling tools |
    86→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | frontend | Add IPC handlers for annotation events |
    87→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI |
    88→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/fr/common.json` | frontend | Add i18n keys for annotation UI (French) |
    89→
    90→## Files to Reference
    91→
    92→These files show patterns to follow:
    93→
    94→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    95→|------|----------------|
    96→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts` | MCP tool registration pattern |
    97→| `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts` | MCP server tool implementation |
    98→| `apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/mcp-handlers.ts` | IPC handler pattern for MCP |
    99→| `apps/frontend/src/renderer/App.tsx` | Conditional component rendering, environment checks |
   100→| `apps/backend/spec_agents/gatherer.py` | Spec/task creation patterns |
   101→| `apps/frontend/src/shared/stores/` | Zustand store patterns |
   102→
   103→## Patterns to Follow
   104→
   105→### Development-Only Component Pattern
   106→
   107→From existing codebase patterns, conditional rendering for dev-only features:
   108→
   109→```tsx
   110→// Only render in development mode
   111→{import.meta.env.DEV && (
   112→  <AnnotationOverlay
   113→    onAnnotationSubmit={handleAnnotationSubmit}
   114→  />
   115→)}
   116→```
   117→
   118→**Key Points:**
   119→- Use `import.meta.env.DEV` for Vite-based conditional rendering
   120→- Avoid `process.env.NODE_ENV` direct checks in renderer (use Vite's approach)
   121→- Ensure component tree-shakes out of production builds
   122→
   123→### MCP Tool Registration Pattern
   124→
   125→From `apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts`:
   126→
   127→```typescript
   128→// Register new tool with MCP server
   129→server.tool(
   130→  'create_annotation_task',
   131→  {
   132→    description: 'Create a task/spec from a UI annotation',
   133→    inputSchema: {
   134→      type: 'object',
   135→      properties: {
   136→        screenshot: { type: 'string', description: 'Base64 screenshot' },
   137→        coordinates: { type: 'object', properties: { x: { type: 'number' }, y: { type: 'number' } } },
   138→        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Issue description' },
   139→        severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] }
   140→      },
   141→      required: ['description']
   142→    }
   143→  },
   144→  async (args) => {
   145→    // Implementation
   146→  }
   147→);
   148→```
   149→
   150→**Key Points:**
   151→- Follow existing tool registration structure
   152→- Include proper input schema validation
   153→- Return structured responses
   154→
   155→### Zustand Store Pattern
   156→
   157→From existing stores in the codebase:
   158→
   159→```typescript
   160→import { create } from 'zustand';
   161→
   162→interface AnnotationStore {
   163→  isAnnotationMode: boolean;
   164→  annotations: Annotation[];
   165→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => void;
   166→  addAnnotation: (annotation: Annotation) => void;
   167→  clearAnnotations: () => void;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export const useAnnotationStore = create<AnnotationStore>((set) => ({
   171→  isAnnotationMode: false,
   172→  annotations: [],
   173→  toggleAnnotationMode: () => set((state) => ({ isAnnotationMode: !state.isAnnotationMode })),
   174→  addAnnotation: (annotation) => set((state) => ({ annotations: [...state.annotations, annotation] })),
   175→  clearAnnotations: () => set({ annotations: [] }),
   176→}));
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Key Points:**
   180→- Use TypeScript interfaces for store shape
   181→- Keep store actions minimal and focused
   182→- Expose selectors for derived state
   183→
   184→### i18n Pattern
   185→
   186→From existing translation files:
   187→
   188→```json
   189→{
   190→  "annotation": {
   191→    "mode": {
   192→      "enable": "Enable annotation mode",
   193→      "disable": "Disable annotation mode"
   194→    },
   195→    "submit": "Submit annotation",
   196→    "description": "Describe the issue",
   197→    "severity": {
   198→      "label": "Severity",
   199→      "low": "Low",
   200→      "medium": "Medium",
   201→      "high": "High",
   202→      "critical": "Critical"
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→```
   207→
   208→**Key Points:**
   209→- Always use translation keys, never hardcoded strings
   210→- Add to both `en` and `fr` locale files
   211→- Use nested structure for organization
   212→
   213→## Requirements
   214→
   215→### Functional Requirements
   216→
   217→1. **Annotation Mode Toggle**
   218→   - Description: Users can enable/disable annotation mode via a toolbar button
   219→   - Acceptance: Toggle button visible in dev mode only, state persists during session
   220→
   221→2. **Visual Annotation Drawing**
   222→   - Description: When annotation mode is active, users can click/drag to highlight UI areas
   223→   - Acceptance: Annotations appear as visual overlays with bounding boxes
   224→
   225→3. **Annotation Description Input**
   226→   - Description: Users can add text descriptions and severity levels to annotations
   227→   - Acceptance: Form appears after marking an area, captures description + severity
   228→
   229→4. **Screenshot Capture**
   230→   - Description: System automatically captures screenshot of annotated area
   231→   - Acceptance: Screenshot stored with annotation data for context
   232→
   233→5. **Task Creation from Annotation**
   234→   - Description: Submitted annotations create task entries in spec format
   235→   - Acceptance: New spec folder created in `.auto-claude/specs/` with annotation data
   236→
   237→6. **Annotation List View**
   238→   - Description: Users can view all annotations made in current session
   239→   - Acceptance: List shows all annotations with ability to edit/delete
   240→
   241→### Non-Functional Requirements
   242→
   243→1. **Dev-Only Activation**
   244→   - Description: Feature completely absent from production builds
   245→   - Acceptance: No annotation code in production bundle, verified via bundle analysis
   246→
   247→2. **React 19 Compatibility**
